'''2008 Worlds Team Luke N. LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Luke N.]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Informal sheet. Incomplete surname as written. Shields mixed into main list on scan; separated best-effort. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Feel The Conflict|There Is Good In Him]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
